summary: Practise customer verification, risk ratings and KYC case documentation. Review the course outline and see how it fits your compliance work.
lede: Know your customer (KYC) practice helps onboarding and compliance professionals make consistent, evidence-based customer due diligence decisions. The course covers verifying identity evidence, mapping beneficial ownership, assessing customer risk and deciding when enhanced due diligence or escalation is warranted. Participants also practise documenting case rationales and planning periodic or event-driven reviews through customer-file workshops.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess customer identity, ownership, financial crime exposure or the quality of KYC decisions in onboarding and ongoing review.
modules: KYC Control Ownership and Customer Lifecycle
prerequisites: Prior exposure to customer onboarding, compliance operations or financial-services customer records is recommended. You should be able to review basic customer documentation; no coding or specialist software is required.
